# Coder role

Fixture file, standing in for a role document that cites conventions in prose
rather than from a manifest line, and in the second of the two cite-dirs.

The coder honours old-name before every commit, and `old-name` in backticks is
the same citation as the bare form: the markdown decoration around a name is not
part of the token.

Nothing here cites the third convention in the topic file, which is what makes
the two deletion cases testable.
